d:
Watch this melodious song, 'Mujhe Kitna Pyaar Hai Tumse' from the classic movie, 'Dil Tera Deewana' sung by Legends, 'Lata Mangeshkar' & 'Mohammed Rafi' starring Legendary Actor 'Shammi Kapoor' & 'Mala Sinha' in the lead roles along with the maestros of comedy, 'Mehmood' & 'Shubha Khote' and the all time versatile actor, 'Pran'.
Credits:
Song Name : Mujhe Kitna Pyaar Hai Tumse
Cast: Shammi Kapoor, Mala Sinha, Pran, Mehmood, Shubha Khote
Director: B.R. Panthulu
Music: Shankar Jaikishan
Producer: B.R. Panthulu
